title: 第一卷 第10章 极道帝兵，万欲神炉！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
姜临渊本就是姜家族老中，脾气最为火爆的一个。

    从踏入帝都的那一刻起，他就憋了一肚子火！

    太凰仙朝这些人平日里高高在上，作威作福的惯了，面对姜家的提亲，居然也敢摆谱，言辞之中满是对帝子的蔑视与嘲讽。

    若不是姜临天多次制止，他早就动手，把太凰殿都给掀了！

    可如今，一个乳臭未干的臭丫头，居然三番两次的找茬，分明就是不把姜家放在眼里。

    这还忍个屁啊！

    “一个小小的皇族公主，怎敢一而再，再而三的藐视姜家帝威，真当帝族姜家好欺负吗？”

    “我告诉你，帝子乃大帝唯一血脉，身份何其尊贵？别说你只是神体，就算是圣体天骄，想嫁给帝子为妾，也得看我们帝子点不点头！”

    “你既存心找茬，自当惩戒！”

    说完，姜临渊以指代剑，朝着沐风凰打去。

    一瞬间，殿内皇族众人脸色大变。

    “姜临渊，你敢！”

    “狂妄！”

    “阻止他！”

    暴喝声中，沐乾钊众人几乎同时出手。

    姜临天见状，当即大手一挥，祭出了一方神炉！

    极道帝兵，万欲神炉！

    姜无痕的父亲名为姜临御，被世人称作恒御大帝。

    这万欲神炉，便是他当初的证道帝兵之一！

    当然，这是姜家辛秘，只有家族的高层核心知晓。

    万欲神炉一出，顷刻间风云骤起，天地变色。

    皇族众强者纷纷受欲火焚身，一些圣人王、大圣强者无法抵抗，当即喷出一口鲜血，昏死过去。

    沐乾钊和苏灵熙夫妇硬抗极道帝兵威压，为沐启凌争得一线机会，护在了沐风凰身前。

    可即便如此，还是慢了一瞬。

    对于姜临渊这位准帝第八重的强者而言，沐风凰实在太过脆弱。

    仅仅是一缕余威，都足以将其重创。

    刹那间，沐风凰面容扭曲，口中喷出一串血花，连同丹田破碎。

    她在极致的震撼与惊恐中，直接昏死过去。

    沐启凌护住了她的残躯，修为却在不断流失……

    她的境界，彻底崩碎！

    这一刻，沐启凌目眦俱裂，咬牙切齿道：“姜临渊，你放肆！”

    “这里是太凰仙朝，还轮不到你在此无法无天！”

    “你敢废我族天骄，老夫就让你命丧帝都！”

    说罢，沐启凌挥手祭出一面古朴铜镜，散发出准帝兵的威压。

    “就凭你？”
content_en:
Jiang Linyuan was originally the oldest member of the Jiang family and the one with the hottest temper.

From the moment he stepped into the imperial capital, he was filled with anger!

People like Taihuang Immortal Dynasty were usually aloof and domineering, but when faced with the Jiang family's marriage proposal, they actually dared to show off, and their words were full of contempt and ridicule for the emperor's son.

If Jiang Lintian hadn't stopped him many times, he would have taken action and demolished the Taihuang Palace!

But now, a smelly girl who is still young is actually looking for trouble again and again. She clearly doesn't take the Jiang family seriously.

How can I bear this?

"How can a little royal princess dare to despise the Jiang family's imperial power over and over again? Do you really think that the imperial Jiang family is easy to bully?"

"Let me tell you, the emperor's son is the only bloodline of the emperor. How noble is his status? Don't say that you are just a divine body. Even if you are a Holy Body genius, if you want to marry the emperor as your concubine, you still have to see whether our emperor nods!"

"Since you are deliberately looking for trouble, you should be punished!"

After saying that, Jiang Linyuan pointed his sword at Mu Fenghuang.

In an instant, the expressions of everyone in the royal family changed drastically.

"Jiang Linyuan, how dare you!"

"Arrogant!"

"Stop him!"

Amidst the loud shouts, Mu Qianzhao and others took action almost at the same time.

When Jiang Lintian saw this, he immediately waved his hand and sacrificed a sacred furnace!

The ultimate imperial weapon, the divine furnace of all desires!

Jiang Wuhen's father was named Jiang Linyu, and he was called Emperor Hengyu by the world.

This Divine Furnace of Ten Thousand Desires was one of his original Emperor's Soldiers for Proving the Dao!

Of course, this is a secret of the Jiang family, and only the top core members of the family know it.

As soon as the Divine Furnace of All Desires came out, the storm suddenly rose and the color of the heaven and earth changed.

All the powerful men in the royal family were burned by desire. Some saint kings and great sage powerful men could not resist. They immediately spit out a mouthful of blood and passed out.

Mu Qianzhao and Su Lingxi and his wife resisted the pressure of the Jidao Emperor soldiers, fought for a chance for Mu Qiling, and protected Mu Fenghuang.

But even so, it was still a moment slow.

For Jiang Linyuan, a strong man at the eighth level of Quasi-Emperor, Mu Fenghuang was too fragile.

Just a ray of lingering power is enough to severely damage it.

In an instant, Mu Fenghuang's face was distorted, a string of blood spurted out from his mouth, and his dantian was shattered.

She was so shocked and frightened that she fainted.

Mu Qiling protected her remaining body, but her cultivation was constantly losing...

Her realm was completely shattered!

At this moment, Mu Qiling's eyes were split, and he gritted his teeth and said: "Jiang Linyuan, you are so presumptuous!"

"This is Taihuang Immortal Dynasty, it's not your turn to be lawless here!"

"If you dare to destroy the genius of our clan, I will kill you in the imperial capital!"

After saying that, Mu Qiling waved his hand and held out a simple bronze mirror, exuding the coercion of a quasi-emperor soldier.

"Just you?"
